checkpoints.if_window_missed: Record WINDOW_MISSED/overall BLOCKED with functional acceptance separate; do not relabel later reopen as durable partial checkpoint PASS.
checkpoints.pending_visibility: Record staged_committed_rows separately; pending must not appear as published rows, report sums or export data.
checkpoints.unobservable_pending_window: NOT_MEASURED visibility-window observation; final counts alone do not prove every intermediate window.
checkpoints.default_parse_scope: CSV workloads require cooperative_cancel_partial_parse_same_job. Rich mini still requires completed-validation restart; optional unobserved probes are not claimed.
checkpoints.stop_method: Existing public cancel API after a durable parsed/checkpoint counter >=500 and <source_rows. Await CANCELLED with partial count before graceful owned process close.
checkpoints.restart_job_state: CANCELLED with identical parsed checkpoint, batch/job/book/file/file_hash; explicit existing resume API afterwards. Not a RECOVERABLE/crash claim.
checkpoints.closed_checkpoint_proof: After verified sidecar exit and closed WAL, open only synthetic DB read-only immutable: require state CANCELLED, 500<=parsed<source_rows, staged count=distinct source IDs=job counter=checkpoint, parse:{parsed} receipt/result; hash ordered row_id/source_sheet/source_row/raw_json prefix.
checkpoints.final_checkpoint_retention: After resumed complete parse and final exit: staged/distinct source rows equal input rows; original stopped receipt payload and source-prefix SHA retained; published=lineage=distinct targets and two publications.
checkpoints.cancel_race_policy: A pre-cancel 500-row observation is insufficient if cooperative cancellation stops at all source rows. WINDOW_MISSED remains BLOCKED for required checkpoint scope.

generator_reference.note: Reference algorithm only. Parent owns pure packaged-fixture generator; do not run the old in-process benchmark as packaged evidence.

rules.original_ordinal: i-1 if i mod1000=2 else i
rules.category: Robusta for odd original_ordinal, Arabica otherwise
rules.note: =literal source text if original_ordinal mod113=0; otherwise Cà phê tổng hợp, kiểm chứng
rules.exact_duplicate_extra_rows: i mod1000=2 repeats previous valid row across all eight columns
rules.repair: For invalid source_row r, replace amount with cents_for(r-1) formatted scale2
rules.decisions: keep all exact-duplicate warnings; exclude none

csv_v1.counts_policy: Duplicate flags overlap valid rows. Do not add valid+invalid+duplicate flags as disjoint source counts.
csv_v1.money_representation: integer-cent strings plus Decimal VND strings; never float

rich_mini.exact_money_expectations: Required from rich fixture manifest; null here is unavailable, never zero and never CSV-v1 totals.
rich_mini.macro_external_policy: XLSM is a genuine inert fixture from its manifest, raw original bytes preserved; no macro, DDE or external-reference execution. XLSX is its separately hashed rich GUI input, not a renamed XLSM.

measurement_contract.clock: Windows monotonic high-resolution QueryPerformanceCounter/perf_counter; record implementation and resolution
measurement_contract.pid_role_rule: Parser/API/worker may share one serving-sidecar PID; one process record with multiple roles. PID reuse requires creation_time.
cpu: GetProcessTimes combined user+kernel seconds since process start per PID+creation_filetime_100ns
resource_summary.cpu_observed_delta_seconds = last sampled minus first sampled combined CPU seconds; excludes unobserved startup/exit intervals
Per-stage samples exist; separate per-phase CPU delta and percent normalization are NOT_MEASURED unless derived and labelled explicitly.
memory: GetProcessMemoryInfo WorkingSetSize sampled peak by unique PID
PrivateUsage sampled peak by unique PID
PeakWorkingSetSize cumulative since process creation, not phase-local
measurement_contract.memory_aggregation: NONE: never sum parser/API/worker roles or app/WebView RSS into a unique-memory total; shared pages/process role aliases would double count.
measurement_contract.ui_memory_in_headless_mode: NOT_MEASURED; GUI execution evidence remains NOT_RUN
measurement_contract.missing_metric: NOT_MEASURED with null, not numeric zero
measurement_contract.os_temp: NOT_MEASURED unless actual owned paths/measurement method are recorded; app-root sampling does not cover PyInstaller extraction or all SQLite OS-temp files.
measurement_contract.p95_definition: linear interpolation at zero-based rank (n-1)*0.95; null for n=0; record definition with every result
measurement_contract.latency_scope: State whether direct API or real GUI; mixed pending/published samples are not steady-state full-data measurements.
claim_limits: No old source timing copied as packaged/native measurement
No quiet/fastest-host claim from a coordinator slot alone
No headless or browser harness relabelled real GUI
No NSIS build relabelled clean-Windows install/offline PASS
measurement_contract.process_identity_scope: Current Windows snapshots supply these fields; architecture is NOT_MEASURED. Descendant image SHA and detailed role classification are planned, not emitted by the sampler.

availability_without_separate_evidence.all_phase_receipt_counts_and_dbstat: NOT_MEASURED; only stopped parse receipt is verified by the closed checkpoint probe when that scope succeeds.

measurement_contract.latency_summary_implementation: Current helper emits count/p50/p95/max grouped by request label. Explicit timeout/failure aggregate counters are NOT_MEASURED; an operation failure still fails the run with its reason code. Not every planned GUI operation is implemented.
measurement_contract.disk_implementation: Samples synthetic data-root database_bytes/wal_bytes/shm_bytes/app_data_bytes/app_import_temp_bytes plus free-volume before/after. app_import_temp_bytes counts files under any imports path, not isolated transient temp; originals/export may be inside app_data_bytes and are not disjoint totals. Fixture/controller output tree and OS temp are outside this sampler.

implementation_alignment.manifest_consumption: Runner binds this file SHA in result; CLI WORKLOADS and acceptance/fixture code drive execution. It does not interpret every planned assertion or metric from this JSON.
implementation_alignment.slot_gate: rows>=50000: frozen-sidecar and valid explicit final-candidate slot before output/fixture creation. Mini and named authorized csv-checkpoint-5000: optional receipt validated when supplied; approved frozen identity still required.
implementation_alignment.output_gate: Fresh resolved local output-root outside repository; existing roots and UNC paths rejected.
implementation_alignment.source_gate: Current Git HEAD recorded; dirty backend/frontend/src/desktop rejected; Python source sidecar never relabelled frozen.
implementation_alignment.frozen_gate: Candidate source equals --expected-source-sha; local absolute .exe/positive bytes/raw SHA checked; launched root image path checked and Python fallback denied; artifact SHA checked after run. Trusted coordinator declaration, not embedded source attestation. Final-candidate designation is external coordinator approval, not independently attested by this CLI.
result_hashes: candidate identity manifest SHA when frozen
source and downloaded original raw SHA256
implementation_alignment.rich_restart: Completed first validation before decisions; invalid17 and zero published rows checked after restart. This is not mid-parse recovery.
implementation_alignment.csv_restart: Public API cooperative cancel at observed durable parse>=500; wait for CANCELLED partial, close owned sidecar, verify closed checkpoint DB/receipt/staging/prefix, restart same CANCELLED job with identical source/checkpoint, then explicit resume. Full stopped count is WINDOW_MISSED/BLOCKED. Not RECOVERABLE or crash recovery. Explicit resume must complete the same parse job, full parsed checkpoint and exactly one generation increment.
implementation_alignment.closed_reconciliation: After verified owned-sidecar exit and closed WAL: immutable read-only synthetic DB verifies published=lineage=distinct targets and two PUBLISHED attempts. Successful cancelled checkpoint additionally verifies retained prefix/receipt and complete resumed distinct staged IDs.
implementation_alignment.export_limit: Current acceptance streams derived CSV with bounded 256KiB line limit; checks raw bytes/SHA, exact header/record width, data-row/cell counts and Decimal income against fixture expectations. This is synthetic derived-export reconciliation, not original workbook fidelity.
implementation_alignment.gui_limit: No GUI mode or desktop-mini-xlsx-1000 in this CLI. Separate real native app acceptance required. Headless GUI measurements NOT_MEASURED; GUI evidence NOT_RUN.
implementation_alignment.checkpoint_receipts: Single stopped parse receipt/result/counter and staged-prefix digest verified read-only after exit, then retained receipt/prefix and complete distinct source count checked at final exit. Expected total receipt counts are not runtime inventory.
implementation_alignment.newer_parent_edits: Parent owns runner/acceptance/measurements and may extend them; result harness file hashes identify the implementation actually run.

definition_delta.scope: Named bounded 5000-row cooperative checkpoint test; no execution evidence added and historical results unchanged.
